method: 4096x4096 pixel-center triangle rasterization; strict barycentric interior epsilon 1e-7; shared edges excluded; subpixel overlap is not excluded analytically.
raster_padding_note: Eight-neighbor simultaneous island dilation; first collision step bounds occupied-pixel clearance to about 2*step-2 .. 2*step pixels. This is a raster measurement, not an exact edge-distance guarantee; tiny islands may cover no pixel centers.
density_policy: All UV islands normalized by physical surface area, then fitted together into one 4096 atlas with 0.002 packing margin. 800 px/m is the nominal target; actual density is bounded by the achieved packing.
